name: clean-trips
description: Cleans raw Chicago taxi data (historical BigQuery data or landed live data) into silver trips and outcomes.

parameters.name: source
parameters.label: Source
parameters.helpText: historical (BigQuery public table) or live (landing files). Default: historical.

parameters.name: dataset
parameters.label: Dataset
parameters.helpText: trips, outcomes or all. Live trips and outcomes arrive at different times, so run them separately. Default: all.

parameters.name: end_date
parameters.label: End date
parameters.helpText: Day after the last day to process, exclusive (YYYY-MM-DD).

parameters.name: out_lake
parameters.label: Lake bucket
parameters.helpText: Lake bucket without a trailing slash, e.g. gs://chicago-taxi-tips-project-lake

parameters.name: run_ts
parameters.label: Run timestamp
parameters.helpText: Optional UTC run timestamp YYYYMMDD-HHMMSS; generated if empty.
